Company Description
At ServiceNow, our technology makes the world work for everyone, and our people make it possible. We move fast because the world can’t wait, and we innovate in ways no one else can for our customers and communities. By joining ServiceNow, you are part of an ambitious team of change makers who have a restless curiosity and a drive for ingenuity.

We know that your best work happens when you live your best life and share your unique talents, so we do everything we can to make that possible. We dream big together, supporting each other to make our individual and collective dreams come true. The future is ours, and it starts with you.
With more than 7,700+ customers, we serve approximately 85% of the Fortune 500®, and we're proud to be one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® and World's Most Admired Companies™.
Learn more on Life at Now blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at ServiceNow.
Unsure if you meet all the qualifications of a job description but are deeply excited about the role? We still encourage you to apply! At ServiceNow, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all voices are heard, valued, and respected.

We welcome all candidates, including individuals from non-traditional, varied backgrounds, that might not come from a typical path connected to this role. We believe skills and experience are transferrable, and the desire to dream big makes for great candidates.
Job Description

ServiceNow empowers organizations with AI-driven autonomous workflows to streamline operations and achieve results. We seek an experienced solution sales specialist with business expertise and technical skills to drive growth for our Finance, Procurement, and Legal Workflow solutions.

This quota carrying sales role will partner with enterprise sales teams to identify opportunities, lead strategic discovery, demonstrate solutions, and close complex deals. Your dual expertise—part consultant, part seller—positions you to bridge technical capability and business value in ways that resonate with executive stakeholders.

Build and refine the qualification criteria, account strategy, sales motion, and the pitch.
Build pipeline and generate revenue for Autonomous Finance, Procurement, and Legal Workflow solutions.
Lead executive discovery sessions to uncover challenges and quantify AI value.
Develop account strategies focused on customer transformation.
Deliver impactful demonstrations and handle technical questions.
Establish trusted relationships with executive sponsors and collaborate across teams.
Stay informed about emerging AI technologies and workflow automation trends.
What Makes You Successful
Balance executive presence with technical know-how.
Simplify technology into clear business narratives.
Thrive in ambiguous situations and solve complex problems.
Prioritize high-impact opportunities.
Work well in matrixed environments.

7+ years of enterprise software sales or consulting experience.
Proven success selling complex SaaS, ERP, finance, legal, or AI solutions.
Domain expertise in procurement, financial operations, contract management, or legal tech.
Experience in overlay, matrixed, or specialized sales.
Skilled at leading executive engagements and product demonstrations.
Strong executive communication and organizational skills.
Willingness to travel

Experience selling or working with AI platforms and intelligent automation.
Familiarity with ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle, Workday, Ariba, Coupa, etc.
Knowledge of APIs, integrations, and enterprise architecture.
Active use of AI tools.
MBA or equivalent work experience.

Werde Sales Executive (m/w/d) bei Carwow !

Carwow ist Europas führende Plattform für den Autowechsel – wir verändern, wie Menschen Autos kaufen, verkaufen, inserieren und leasen.

Mit Technologie, Medien und Automotive-Expertise haben wir uns von einer reinen Bewertungsplattform zu einem der größten Online-Marktplätze entwickelt. 2024 wurden über unsere Plattform fast 3 Mrd. £ an Autokäufen und 1,8 Mrd. £ an Fahrzeugverkäufen abgewickelt.

Durch die Übernahme von Autovia (AutoExpress und Evo) haben wir unsere Reichweite verdoppelt: 10 Mio. YouTube-Abonnenten, 1,2 Mio. Magazinverkäufe und mehr als 350 Mio. jährliche Online-Leser:innen. Und wir stehen gerade erst am Anfang.

Als Sales Executive (m/w/d) bist du neben unserem Business Development und dem Account Management der dritte wichtige Baustein unserer Vertriebsspitze. Denn als Sales Executive sorgst du für ein erstklassiges (Ver)Kaufserlebnis unserer Kund:innen und Partner auf unserer Plattform.

Du berätst Verkäufer:innen beim Verkauf ihrer Autos über unsere "Sell My Car"-Plattform und stellst den Kontakt zu Partnerhändlern her, um so ein reibungsloses Kundenerlebnis auf beiden Seiten zu schaffen
Dabei kommunizierst du über verschiedene Kanäle wie zum Beispiel Telefon, E-Mail oder WhatsApp, um einen effizienten Verkaufsprozess zu gewährleisten und steigerst so die Zufriedenheit von Verkäufer:innen und Händlern
Denn ohne dein Zutun würden viele Verkäufe sprichwörtlich auf der Strecke bleiben, du bist das Bindeglied zwischen Verkäufer:innen und Händlern und sorgst so kontinuierlich für hohe Verkaufsquoten

Hinweis: Niemand erfüllt alle Anforderungen zu 100 %. Wenn du dich stark mit der Rolle identifizierst und Lust auf Automotive hast, dann freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.
Kommunikationsstärke und ein sicheres Auftreten - auch bei unterschiedlichen Zielgruppen
Erfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise aus dem Automotive Retail / Autohandel oder vergleichbaren Rollen, sowie Empathie und zwischenmenschliches Gespür
Begeisterung für die Automobilbranche: Du bist bestens über Trends und Entwicklungen informiert und weißt, was “da draußen im Markt” passiert
Analytisches Denken: Die Fähigkeit, Daten zu nutzen, um Chancen und Risiken zu erkennen
Hands-on-Mentalität, hohe Eigenmotivation und Belastbarkeit in einem dynamischen Scale-up

In der Regel kannst du etwa mit zwei bis drei Wochen für den Bewerbungsprozess rechnen.
Talent Screen (telefonisch) mit unserem Recruiting Team - ca. 30 Minuten
Video Interview (online) mit dem Fachbereich - ca. 30 Minuten
Case Study (vor Ort) mit dem Fachbereich - ca. 60 Minuten
Final Values & Team Fit (vor Ort oder online) nach Möglichkeit im Anschluss an deine Case Study - ca. 30 Minuten

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

We're looking for an energetic, curious, and team-oriented people. You should have a passion for communication and languages, and a desire to be part of a hyper-growth scale-up!

Inbound Lead Management
Respond rapidly to inbound leads from contact forms, free trials, webinars, and content downloads

Nurture prospects who aren't immediately ready, keeping them warm with helpful content and well-timed follow-up
Own end-to-end follow-up for event leads, maintaining quality and speed even during high-volume periods

Apply a structured qualification framework to ensure every meeting is well-documented and properly qualified
Convert inbound interest into well-prepared, qualified sales opportunities
Articulate the value of our product suite clearly, creating curiosity and clear next steps
Meet and exceed monthly targets for pipeline contribution
Stakeholder & Team Collaboration
Work closely with stakeholders based in Germany, taking initiative to keep communication proactive across time zones and locations
Maintain accurate, complete records in your CRM for every interaction
Share insights on lead quality and messaging effectiveness to help improve campaign performance
Bring ideas that help the team improve how it converts inbound interest, moving beyond a purely passive, reactive approach

Fluency in German and English (written and spoken)
Around 12 months of relevant sales or customer-facing experience (SDR/BDR/Inside Sales), ideally in SaaS
Highly organised, with strong personal initiative — comfortable driving your own workload with minimal oversight
Confidence working with stakeholders based remotely in Germany
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build rapport quickly
Strong time management; able to juggle multiple leads, channels, and priorities
Nice-to-Haves
Some outbound prospecting experience
Experience with DACH enterprise or mid-market prospects
Familiarity with CRM and sales engagement tools (e.g. Salesforce, Salesloft)
Interest in helping improve how the team converts and engages inbound leads
Fluency in another European language

You consistently deliver qualified meetings per month with strong opportunity acceptance rates
You maintain rapid speed-to-lead across all inbound channels
German-based stakeholders value your proactive communication and reliability
You contribute ideas that help sharpen how the team converts and engages inbound interest
You demonstrate growing commercial judgement and confidence handling a wider range of inbound scenarios

We are an equal opportunity employer

The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! Our leading SaaS-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. At G-P, we’re dedicated to breaking down barriers to global business and creating opportunities for everyone, everywhere.
Our diverse, remote-first teams are essential to our success. We empower our Dream Team members with flexibility and resources, fostering an environment where innovation thrives and every contribution is valued and celebrated.
The work you do here will positively impact lives around the world. We stand by our promise: Opportunity Made Possible. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we invite you to join us in expanding your skills and helping to reshape the future of work.
At G-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months—streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all.
About The Position: We are seeking a highly motivated, resilient, and results-driven Outbound Business Development Representative to join our fast-growing company. In this role, you won't be waiting for leads to come to you—you will be the engine driving our front-line growth.

As an Outbound BDR, you will focus strictly on net-new business acquisition, identifying high-value targets, mapping out key decision-makers, and executing rigorous cold outreach strategies.

The ideal candidate is a true hunter with a passion for the thrill of the chase, excellent objection-handling skills, and a strategic mindset for penetrating cold accounts. This is an exciting opportunity to be a critical pipeline driver in a high-growth SaaS environment. What You Will Do:

Drive Outbound Pipeline: Proactively prospect, map, and penetrate target accounts using a mix of multi-channel outreach, including high-volume cold calling, personalized email sequences, LinkedIn video/voice notes, and other creative social selling tactics.

Execute Strategic Account Mapping: Research enterprise and mid-market organizations to identify key decision-makers (C-level, HR Leaders, CFOs) and uncover hidden pain points related to global expansion.

Own the First Touch: Conduct high-impact discovery conversations with cold prospects, effectively educating them on G-P’s Employer of Record (EOR) value proposition, overcoming initial friction, and booking qualified meetings for the Account Executive team.

Manage Objections: Confidently navigate gatekeepers and handle complex objections regarding global payroll, compliance, and competing solutions.

Data-Driven Prospecting: Maintain meticulous records of your outreach sequences, account maps, and conversion metrics within our CRM (Salesforce) and sales engagement tools (e.g., Outreach/Salesloft).

Market Intelligence: Stay ahead of macroeconomic trends, geopolitical shifts, and competitor movements to sharply position G-P as the definitive global employment solution.

Hit the Numbers: Consistently meet or exceed monthly quotas for cold outreach activity, qualified opportunities generated, and pipeline contribution.

The Hunter Mindset: Proven track record in a pure outbound sales development, lead generation, or cold-calling heavy role (SaaS experience highly preferred).

Resilience & Grit: High emotional intelligence with the ability to handle rejection professionally, pivot strategies quickly, and maintain high energy throughout the day.

Prospecting Skills: Will to learn and use tools (e.g. Cognism, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach, Salesforce,).

Elite Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to write highly personalized, compelling cold copy that cuts through the noise.

Strategic Thinking: Ability to understand complex business models and articulate how a global EOR platform solves specific corporate expansion pain points.

Self-Starter: Highly organized, disciplined, and capable of managing a high volume of outbound activity independently in a remote-first environment.

Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with the Employer of Record industry, HR outsourcing, global payroll, or workforce management is a massive plus but not essential

Education: Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field is preferred but not essential
The annual gross fixed pay range for this position is €33,600 - €41,250 plus variable compensation.

Our ranges are established using objective market benchmarking data for this level of work. Final placement within the range is determined by gender-neutral criteria, including the candidate's relevant skills, experience, and specific qualifications for the role.
Actual compensation for this position may vary and will depend on multiple factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. For Full-Time Regular Employees, this position is also eligible for additional compensation as follows:

Sales Roles: This position is eligible for a commission structure in addition to base salary.
Non-Sales Roles: This position is eligible for an annual bonus which is paid dependent on various factors, including and without limitation, individual and company performance in addition to base salary.

From global banks to high street retailers, our programs are designed shift behaviour, boost ROI and build genuine brand love – at the fraction of the cost of discounting and cash offers.

Backed by COSMOS, our all-in-one program platform, we deliver personalised campaigns at scale with live data, smart insights, and seamless customer journeys. We’ve spent 30 years mastering what moves customers; combining deep consumer insight, a global network of 100,000+ rewards, and a unique ability to drive measurable ROI for brands.

We’re 400+ people strong, across 15 global hubs. A collective of marketers, creatives and strategists who care about doing great work - and having fun while we do it. And none of this is possible without our partners.
That’s where you come in. You’ll own the full journey of bringing high-quality partners into our network.

Commission paid on every successful new partner signed
Earnings linked directly to volume, quality, and scale
Transparent monthly & quarterly targets
Strong upside for those who consistently exceed expectations This role will be supporting the US market and will require working US hours

Driving high-volume outbound activity, with a strong focus on cold calling and partner acquisition for independent businesses across Germany
Researching and identifying new venue partners, building a consistent and proactive prospecting pipeline
Engaging decision-makers, pitching TLC’s offering and closing new partnerships
Reconnecting with previously engaged or inactive venues to unlock new opportunities
Delivering compelling, consultative sales conversations that bring our products to life
Managing your activity in line with daily KPIs, call targets and conversion goals
Keeping CRM systems accurate and up to date to track performance and pipeline health
Collaborating with the team, sharing insights and bringing energy to a target-driven sales environment
Supporting partner onboarding, product queries and reporting requirements as needed

Experience in telesales, cold calling or lead generation
Comfortable operating in a KPI-driven, target-focused role with high daily call volumes
A resilient, self-motivated “hunter” mindset with a passion for winning new business
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage and influence quickly over the phone
Positive, energetic attitude, someone who thrives in a fast-moving, performance-led environment
A native/ bilingual Spanish speaker

Report directly to Qdrant's Enterprise sales leaders and act as an extension of their account strategy.
Run outbound prospecting into named enterprise accounts, targeting engineering, AI, and data leaders building retrieval and agentic AI systems.
Qualify and progress inbound leads generated by marketing, content, and community channels.
Research target accounts to identify expansion opportunities within existing customers and new logos in strategic segments.

Depending on your experience, you may join us as an early-career Sales Executive ready to develop quickly, or as a more experienced Account Executive capable of owning opportunities independently. This is not a scripted sales role.

You will need to understand technology, ask intelligent questions and connect customer challenges with the right commercial and technical solutions.

Approximately 50% of your working day will require fluent English , both written and spoken, including customer meetings, internal collaboration, proposals, presentations and communication with international technology partners. What You Will Do
Build and manage a pipeline of AI deployment, SaaS subscription and professional services opportunities across EMEA.
Identify and engage relevant decision-makers through outbound prospecting, networking, events, partner referrals and inbound opportunities.
Conduct discovery meetings to understand customer objectives, technical environments and commercial priorities.
Position solutions involving OpenAI, Anthropic, ElevenLabs, FinAI, Braze, OneSignal, Asana, Mixpanel and other leading technology platforms.
Work closely with solution consultants and Forward-Deployed Engineers to shape proposals, demonstrations, pilots and deployment plans.
Manage the sales process from initial contact through qualification, proposal, negotiation and closing.
Develop clear commercial proposals covering subscriptions, implementation services and ongoing support.
Maintain accurate opportunity, activity and forecast information in the CRM.
Build long-term relationships with customers and identify renewal, expansion and cross-sell opportunities.
Collaborate with international partner and vendor sales teams on joint opportunities and go-to-market initiatives.
Continuously improve your understanding of AI, SaaS, enterprise technology and the industries we serve.

s.h: Requirements What We Are Looking For
s.t:
At least one year of experience in B2B sales, business development, account management, partnerships or a similar customer-facing role.
Experience selling or supporting the sale of SaaS subscriptions, cloud solutions, consulting services, implementation projects or other technology solutions.
Professional-level English with strong written and verbal communication skills.
Confidence communicating with both business and technical stakeholders.
A genuine interest in AI, enterprise software and emerging technologies.
The ability to learn new products quickly and explain their business value clearly.
A proactive and disciplined approach to prospecting, follow-up and pipeline management.
Comfort working with targets and a compensation structure consisting of a base salary and performance-based commission.
Strong presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
The ability to take ownership while collaborating closely with commercial and technical teams.
You May Be a Strong Fit If
You are early in your career but have already demonstrated strong commercial potential.
You currently work as a Sales Executive, Account Executive, Business Development Representative, Sales Development Representative or Account Manager.
You want to move from selling a single product into a broader AI and enterprise technology environment.
You are commercially driven but also curious about how technology is implemented and used.
You want exposure to enterprise customers, international technology companies and complex projects.
You are looking for a role where strong performance can lead to significantly greater responsibility.

A competitive base salary with a clear performance-based commission structure.
The opportunity to sell some of the world’s most relevant AI and SaaS technologies.
Direct exposure to enterprise customers and international opportunities across EMEA.
The chance to work closely with experienced consultants, solution architects and Forward-Deployed Engineers.
Structured development across prospecting, discovery, solution selling, negotiation and enterprise account management.
Significant career progression opportunities based on performance and ownership.
Access to partner training, product certifications and industry events.
A fast-moving environment where good ideas and strong results are recognised.
The opportunity to help shape Omtera ’s growing AI deployment business.

An introductory conversation to discuss your experience, motivation and expectations.
A commercial interview focused on your sales approach, communication skills and understanding of technology solutions.

A final conversation with Omtera ’s leadership team.

We’ve built the industry’s leading AI Agent platform for engineering teams, enabling companies to turn complex, manual workflows into automated processes — cutting weeks of engineering work down to minutes.

Our AI agents integrate seamlessly with the tools engineers already use, remove bottlenecks in real-world product development, and help deep-tech companies move faster without compromising quality. In a world where engineering speed is a competitive advantage, Synera is defining the new standard.

Having just closed our series B, we’re a fast-growing team, and we’re rapidly expanding our Revenue teams in Germany and the United States to support increasing demand from innovative deep-tech companies.

If you’re excited about selling cutting-edge AI, working close to the market, and building something early — and if you have big plans for your future — now is the right time to join us. 👉 Your Role Joining us as a Sales Development Representative (SDR) in the US, you’ll be the first voice our future customers hear — C-level deciders, engineering leaders, innovation teams, and thought leaders at forward-thinking deep-tech companies.

Your mission: turn curiosity into conversations, and conversations into real business opportunities. Let’s be real: this role is hands-on. You’ll spend a lot of time picking up the phone, sending messages, following up, and getting through to tough prospects.

Along the way, you will learn how to position and pitch an AI product that delivers value, and how to drive thought leadership in the field of AI. You’ll work closely with Sales and Marketing, test different outreach strategies, and help shape how Synera goes to market in the US.

If you enjoy momentum, love the challenge of getting a “yes” from a skeptical prospect, and want to open doors that lead to big deals — we want to hear from you. If you are hungry to take the first step towards a sales career in one of the most exciting fields there is, you have come to the right place. 👉 Your main focus areas:
Pipeline Building: You qualify leads and set up meetings for the Account Executive team.
Prospect & Qualify: You engage senior leaders and decision-makers via cold outreach (email, LinkedIn, calls, reaching 60+ activities per day).
Outbound Excellence: You shape and manage targeted outbound campaigns, working with the Marketing team to optimize messaging.
Engage & tell great stories: You spark interest in Synera ’s Agentic AI solutions through compelling storytelling and value-driven conversations. You experiment and find creative ways to engage with senior leaders and build trustful relationships
Iterate & Improve: You analyze outreach performance, test new approaches, and refine our SDR playbook.

You know our domain inside out: who our ideal customers are, what keeps them up at night, and how Synera solves their biggest challenges. You have become an AI native, and curiosity is what drives you daily.
You routinely create great Discovery Calls, proving you can turn outreach into meaningful conversations for our Sales team. You have gained great confidence in explaining and pitching a complex tech product.
You are a power user of our tools and workflows - from prospecting platforms to CRM systems. Giving and receiving feedback has become a normal part of your day.
You understand what makes our product special and be able to speak authentically about the value we bring to teams who want to transform what they do with AI. You love to share knowledge and good practices in an international team.

Entry Level (OTE): 73.000 - 89.000$
Intermediate (OTE): 85.000 - 109.000$

While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role. Check out this page to learn how we approach salary, career growth, and creating an environment where everyone can shine. What we offer beyond salary:
Flexible working: you decide when and where to work (as long as you have a residency in the US).

DebtHammer is a dynamic technology startup located in the USA, founded by individuals with experience in working with international remote teams. Our mission is to assist millions of families in breaking free from the payday loan cycle. Each year, 12 million individuals resort to high-interest loans, often becoming trapped in a cycle of perpetual debt. We aim to put an end to this cycle and revolutionize the personal finance industry.
Joining us now presents an exceptional opportunity to play a pivotal role in DebtHammer 's growth journey, working closely with the company's founder. Although our team is currently small, we are rapidly expanding.
We are seeking individuals to join our operations team—individuals who are enthusiastic about building a long-term career with us. If you are sales-oriented, possess a customer-first mindset, and aspire to elevate your customer service and sales skills by joining our remote operations team, we encourage you to apply!

As a Consumer Sales Representative at DebtHammer , your mission is to drive revenue for the company. Your primary responsibility will be engaging with potential customers actively seeking loan relief. We utilize three modes of communication to reach our customers: phone, text, and email.

Once engaged, representatives use open-ended questions and active listening to understand the needs of the customer and position DebtHammer as the best solution. It will be your responsibility to ensure that our customers have an amazing experience with DebtHammer and perceive us as the go-to solution for this industry.
Currently, 100% of our customers are inbound, meaning they searched online, found one of our websites, and indicated that they are looking for payday loan relief.

Must have a minimum of 3 years of solid SALES experience in a call center setting (Non-negotiable requirement).
We are seeking candidates with highly effective English communication skills, both written and verbal, to ensure successful collaboration with our diverse team and stakeholders. Fluency close to native-level proficiency is preferred.
Must have your own laptop or PC, a high-quality headset, high-speed internet, and a backup connection
Must be amenable to working night shifts and overtime
*Please send us a copy of your updated resume that highlights your experience in sales.

What We Expect From You
Minimum 3 years of experience working with actuarial, pricing, or underwriting teams—ideally working with or implementing rating, or pricing software solutions.
Strong understanding of P&C insurance pricing, underwriting workflows, rating engines, and actuarial methodologies.
Demonstrated success partnering with actuarial and underwriting leadership (Chief Actuary, Head of Pricing, CUO, etc.).
Experience with enterprise software evaluation cycles and long, multi-stakeholder decision processes (6–18 months).
Outstanding analytical, conceptual, and communication skills—the ability to translate actuarial concepts into business and technology value.
Proven ability to take ownership and lead complex engagements.
Willingness to travel approximately 50%.
Experience with B2B Enterprise Sales is a strong plus.
What You’ll Be Doing
Partner closely with the VP to shape and execute a pricing- and analytics-focused go-to-market strategy.
Lead consultative discussions with actuarial and underwriting teams to deeply understand their:
Pricing models
Rating algorithms
Workflow pain points
Modernization priorities
Translate actuarial and underwriting needs into clear solution proposals using PricingCenter.
Work with internal account teams to identify opportunities within existing customers to modernize or enhance their pricing programs.
Collaborate with inside sales and marketing to build a pipeline of pricing-focused opportunities with new carriers.
Guide stakeholders through the evaluation of PricingCenter—from first conversation through solution design and commercial agreement.
Represent Guidewire at actuarial, analytics, and underwriting industry events.
Act as a subject-matter conduit between carriers and internal product/engineering teams to inform PricingCenter’s evolving roadmap.

Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) – share in the success of Guidewire.

About Outreach

Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions.

From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team.

World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few.

Our Sales Development team is a culture of success where the future top sellers and leaders of our organization get their start. Our team is responsible for identifying and creating new qualified opportunities for our Account Executive partners.
Our team gains business knowledge through researching how different businesses operate, leadership structures, what their pain points are, and obstacles they face in their business. We then turn around and leverage that information to spark interest in Outreach by connecting the dots from their challenges to the value that Outreach could provide them.
We are product experts for Outreach because we use the very product we sell. This gives SDRs a unique competitive advantage because we understand firsthand how our software can help sales teams be successful.
Many of our SDRs go on to become Account Executives and team leaders within Outreach. This team is built as a launchpad, not a landing spot.

**Join MSF OCG as a Philanthropy Advisor!**
**We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.**
**Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.**
Inclusivity and Diversity at MSF
Do your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?
At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.
We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks.
Context & mission
Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).
The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.
As Philanthropy Advisor, you will secure and grow income from individual major donors in German-speaking Switzerland and Liechtenstein. You will manage a portfolio of assigned donors, build strong and lasting relationships, deepen their engagement with MSF-s social mission, and identify opportunities to increase their support.

This includes organising meetings with MSF representatives, sharing relevant information on MSF projects and priorities, coordinating donor events and webinars, presenting funding opportunities, and directly soliciting financial contributions.

You will also contribute to the effective use of the CRM system and prospect research to strengthen the team-s fundraising approach.

* Manages a portfolio of Major donors
* Is accountable to deliver the best possible experience to MSF key donors in in order to increase their engagement.
* Qualify each Major Donor and Major Donor prospect, in close cooperation with the Prospect Researcher
* In coordination with the Team Coordinator, closely liaise with the Middle Donor manager to identify and update potential Major Donors
* Prepare and facilitate one to one meetings, calls, presentations and other meaningful interactions with major donors or representatives (lawyers, wealth managers, etc.)
* Establish relations with new potential major donors, including high-potential middle givers and other prospects, including ultra-high-net-worth individuals, to secure significant future support for MSF-s work
* Interact and collaborate with key spokespersons within MSF (President, General Director, Director of Operations, other management team members), as well as field staff, with the aim of bringing donors closer to the organisation in an attempt to show them our live saving mission and work in the projects.
* Define, propose and organise visits to MSF offices and projects, in line with MSF criteria and guidance
* Ensure that the nature / identity of donors is in line with MSF gifts acceptance policy.
* Ensure that the moves management runs smoothly, and donors are thanked and steward properly.
* Keep the database up-to-date
* Liaise with Writing Officers for the preparation, including proof reading and editing, of project briefings, reports, proposals, slideshows, infographics and any other creative way of presenting MSF and its mission to private major donors
* Liaise with the Direct Marketing team to adequately leverage marketing appeals and to coordinate touch-points
*Solicitation*
* Present and defend MSF-s cases for support to individual major donors in German speaking Switzerland and Lichtenstein.
* Ensure that the major donors journey strategy is followed and that major donors are solicited according to their motivations in a personalised way.
*Information and data management*
* Closely work with the System Support Team to ensure most efficient use of Customer Relationship Management Database
* Support the Team Coordinator in income forecasting and quarterly analysis of results
*Others*
* Participate in the Community of Practice for Individual Major Donors of MSF
* Work proactively on projects as needed in the Unit, upon request by her/his supervisor.

When it comes to digital communities, The Alliance is leading the way. Product marketing, sales enablement, product-led growth, AI, customer success, CMOs, you name it, we’re home to thriving communities for them all.
With 70,000+ professionals across our communities and a constant stream of events, memberships, and learning products, we help individuals and teams grow faster in their careers. We work with some of the world’s most recognisable companies and pride ourselves on being a high-impact learning partner, not just another events business.
We’re ambitious, we move quickly, and we’re still early in the journey. That means real ownership, a steep learning curve, and plenty of opportunity to shape what comes next.

We’re hiring early-career Sales Associates to join our Delegate & Membership sales team , people with energy, curiosity, and the drive to build a career in commercial roles.
This is a junior role by design. You don’t need years of experience, what matters most is how quickly you learn, how well you take feedback, and how comfortable you are being challenged. We’ll teach you how to sell properly: how to prospect, qualify, handle objections, manage a pipeline, and close, all while speaking to senior decision-makers at some of the world’s biggest tech companies.
You’ll sell across our live events, memberships, and learning solutions in markets including London, New York, San Francisco, Las Vegas and beyond. Over time, this role can progress into more senior sales or specialist commercial paths across the business.
This role is not about arriving fully formed, it’s about building and proving confidence, capability, and momentum through doing.
What You'll Be Doing
Sales Upskilling: You’ll build strong foundations in prospecting, qualification, pipeline management, and closing, while learning how to sell confidently to senior B2B stakeholders and work to clear targets and expectations.
Engaging decision-makers: You’ll speak directly with professionals at fast-growing and enterprise tech companies, understand their challenges, and recommend the right events, memberships, and learning solutions.
Owning deals end-to-end: You’ll own your pipeline from first contact through to close and handover, taking accountability for outcomes and using feedback and data to improve week by week.
Product mastery: You’ll develop strong knowledge of our events, memberships, and education ecosystem, enabling confident and relevant cross-selling.
Collaboration & feedbac k: You’ll work closely with marketing, product, community, and customer success teams, sharing insights and operating with autonomy while knowing when to ask for support.
This Role Is For You If
You’re early in your career and hungry to learn, not entitled to results
You’re comfortable being uncomfortable while learning something new
You actively seek feedback and apply it quickly
You take ownership for outcomes, not just effort
You’re resilient, organised, and able to manage pace and pressure
You communicate clearly with customers and with teammates
You enjoy working as part of a team where success is shared
Our Hiring Process
Our hiring process is designed to reflect how we actually work: collaborative, practical, and focused on potential rather than polish.
First interview (values, motivation, and learning mindset)
One-day assessment in our London office (practical exercises, collaboration, and real-world sales scenarios)
Final shortlist: up to 3 candidates selected into an onboarding cohort, starting together and learning side-by-side
This process helps us understand how you think, learn, and show up — not just how well you interview.

· Du wirst Teil unseres Vertriebsteams und bist für Vertrieb und Vorstellung innovativer Telematik und IIoT-Lösungen – bestehend aus Hardware, Sensorik und Software – auf C-Level-Ebene verantwortlich.

· Du berichtest regelmäßig über Deine Vertriebserfolge bei Management und Stakeholdern.
· Du gehst mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch ans Werk.
**Was wir uns von dir wünschen**
· Du brennst für den Vertrieb komplexer Connectivity-Lösungen im Bereich IIoT, Telematik und Sensorik.
· Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftswissenschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Ingenieurwesen, IT oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
· Du hast mind. drei Jahre einschlägige Vertriebserfahrung und fundiertes Wissen im Vertrieb von Telematik und IIOT-Lösungen.
· Du verfügst idealerweise über tiefgreifendes Prozessverständnis in den Branchen Chemie, Schienenverkehr und Intermodal-Logistik.
· Du bezeichnest dich gerne als überzeugungs- und durchsetzungsstark und siehst deine kommunikativen Fähigkeiten sowie dein ausgeprägtes Präsentationstalent als absolute Stärke.
· Du begeisterst dich für komplexe, technische und prozessorientierte Fragestellungen.

· Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis in Deutschland oder Schweiz.

· Spass bei der Arbeit – wir sind ehrlich und offen zueinander. Wir unterstützen und motivieren uns gegenseitig.

Our Human Health Division maintains a “patient first, profits later” ideology. The organization is comprised of sales, marketing, market access, digital analytics and commercial professionals who are passionate about their role in bringing our medicines to our customers worldwide.
We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Account Manager to manage our existing Pulmonary Hypertension (PH) business and lead the launch of an exciting new product across the Swiss German part of Switzerland.

This role requires strong expertise in pharmaceutical sales, strategic planning and relationship-building with key healthcare professionals. The Account Manager will also work closely with marketing to create and implement impactful materials, projects and campaigns.

While experience in Pulmonary Hypertension and rare diseases is a plus, we welcome candidates with a strong background in pharmaceutical sales who are excited about launching a new product in a very specialized market.

· Manage performance of Pulmonary Hypertension (PH) portfolio, lead the successful launch of a new Pulmonary arterial Hypertension (PAH) product, including market analysis, stakeholder engagement, implementation of launch strategy and monitor territory performance versus targets.

· Build and maintain long-term partnerships with customers (Scientific Leaders, Specialists and specialized Nurses), through individual sales visits, promotional lectures and participation in congresses and educational events.

· Ensure tailored account management for your assigned territory by understanding and mapping your customers, identifying Drivers and Barriers, understanding the patient journey and influencers on treatment decisions per account.

· Engage in balanced product sales discussions including scientific data with Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) to align the customer and business needs.

· Stay up-to date on the latest product and therapeutic area information by attending internal trainings, conferences and symposia, as well as by self-study.

· Drive tailored customer engagements, by using data and analytics to better understand the customer’s preference and by properly balancing physical and digital engagements.

· Organize and co-create educational events for HCP’s including sponsorships in line with strategic priorities and budget constraints.

· Demonstrating highest ethical principles conducting Local law, our company’s Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and regulations.

· 3-5 years of pharmaceutical or biotech sales experience, ideally in specialty care. Experience in Pulmonary Hypertension, Intestinal Lung Disease or Rare Diseases is a strong plus.

· Degree in Life Sciences, medical/paramedical field or another relevant discipline with healthcare curriculum from an accredited institution. shqa Certification «Certified Pharma Sales Representative» is a strong plus.

· Proven experience in managing an existing product portfolio and successfully launching a new product.

· Strong track record of achieving sales targets and supporting marketing efforts in a complex medical environment.

· Excellent communication, relationship-building and presentation skills.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities, with strong organizational and strategic planning skills.

· Experience collaborating with marketing teams to create and implement marketing materials, campaigns and projects.

· Open to innovation and experimentation.

· Fluent in German and additionally English.

· Valid driver’s license.

· Growth-mindset, strong team-player, results-oriented and proven ability to achieve ambitious goals.

· Adaptable to change, ambiguity and a high level of resilience in the face of challenges.

· Independent, motivated and highly organized.

· Excellent interpersonal skills in communication, persuasion and customer relations.

· Possessing a strong learning mindset.

· Identification of challenges or obstacles and proactively ideate on solutions.

· Data-driven decision-making and mindset.

· Comfortable with commercial experimentation and implementing customer projects.

# Un conseiller ou une conseillère en réinsertion pour le bureau AI #
## Temps de travail : 80 % - 100 % ##
L-assurance invalidité (AI) est une assurance sociale obligatoire à l-échelle suisse. Elle soutient les personnes assurées menacées ou touchées par une invalidité par des mesures de réinsertion. L-objectif est que les personnes assurées puissent assurer leur subsistance de manière autonome, totalement ou partiellement. Si une telle réinsertion (ou réintégration) n-est pas ou seulement partiellement possible, l-AI verse une rente (partielle).
Tâches
* Soutien aux personnes avec des limitations de santé pour le maintien de l-emploi ou la recherche d-un poste
* Conduite d-entretiens avec les personnes concernées, les partenaires et les employeurs
* Élaboration d-analyses de situation, de problèmes et de ressources
* Planification de la réinsertion et traitement des décisions d-octroi ou de refus de prestations
* Gestion des dossiers de réinsertion
* Accompagnement des personnes concernées et coordination de tous les intervenants
* Activité sur le terrain dans le canton des Grisons
Exigences
* Personnalité intégrative avec expérience en intégration professionnelle ou assurances sociales
* Formation achevée en coaching/gestion de cas un atout
* Connaissances médicales un atout
* Résistant, sûr de soi en négociation, efficace, orienté client et objectif
* Expression orale et écrite assurée dans les langues cantonales
* Bonnes connaissances informatiques
* Ouverture, communication et esprit d-équipe constructif
* Permis de conduire et véhicule personnel pour l-activité sur le terrain

Quince is a tech company disrupting the retail industry by putting AI, analytics and automation at the center of everything we do. Our unwavering commitment to excellence and company values guide our teams and actions:

s.h: We're looking for Business Development Representatives
s.t:
We’re building a new insurance business from the ground up to protect SMEs, and we’re looking for Business Development Representatives to join our team. If you’re a high-energy communicator who loves building relationships and wants to gain experience, qualifications, and career progression at a leading fintech, apply now.
The company
We're here because we believe in SMEs. We believe they deserve better than confusing jargon, slow and outdated customer experiences, and being caught out by hidden conditions and fees. And we believe it's our job to help them navigate risk with confidence.
Since 2012, iwoca has made finance fast, flexible, and fair for over 150,000 businesses. Now, we're doing the same for insurance. We're building a brand new insurance business from the ground up — to protect SMEs in the moments that matter most.
Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed by providing access to better finance and services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team is a small, entrepreneurial group responsible for launching iwoca's new SME insurance business. Here’s how the team work together:
Customer-obsessed: The team challenges itself to build insurance that its customers actually want, rather than what insurers simply want to sell.
Curious & supportive: The team collaborates across disciplines to find creative solutions to complex problems in a safe and supportive environment.
Move fast & have fun: The team is fast-paced and highly autonomous, but makes sure to celebrate wins and have fun along the way.
Ambitious & entrepreneurial: The environment is ideal for people who thrive on taking ownership of their work and are ready to roll up their sleeves and build.

You’ll be the person introducing our new insurance offering to businesses who are tired of the status quo. You’ll help SMEs move away from complicated, slow insurance policies and make them aware of a fairer, more transparent way to protect their business.

Proactively engage with SME business operators by phone ahead of their business insurance renewal date to offer a better alternative.
Master the art of the pitch—navigating gatekeepers, articulating our value proposition, and turning objections into opportunities for our brokers to help them.
Manage your pipeline end-to-end within our HubSpot CRM, ensuring meticulous record-keeping and proactive follow-ups so that no opportunity is missed.
Collaborate closely with our in-house brokers and wider team to turn early customer feedback into insights that refine our product offering and sales strategy.

Previous experience navigating outbound or client-facing interactions within a professional business environment.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to build rapport, influence decisions, and handle commercial objections over the phone and email.
A high-energy, resilient, and results-oriented personality that thrives on achieving goals. You have sharp problem-solving instincts and a "can-do" mindset.
Organised and proactive approach to managing your workload.
Ability to adapt and excel in a fast-moving, high-growth atmosphere.
Eagerness to learn - insurance industry experience isn’t necessary - we will provide training to help you succeed.
A desire to secure professional qualifications and drive long-term career progression within a rapidly scaling fintech environment

We expect to pay around £30,000 plus bonus for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.
The culture
At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the professional development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage you to explore new areas of interest to help us innovate and improve our products and services.
The offices

## **Conseiller/ère commercial(e) Région Mittelland, Berne et Soleure** ##
*100 % · Bilingue allemand - français · rattaché(e) au responsable des ventes à Eclépens · entrée immédiate ou à convenir*
**Le poste - en résumé**
Ce poste est un rôle classique de chasseur. Votre première tâche n'est pas de gérer un portefeuille clients existant, mais d'en construire un. Vous identifiez les entreprises industrielles de votre région qui ne collaborent pas encore avec CRIDEC, ouvrez des portes, construisez un pipeline de nouveaux clients - et le maintenez systématiquement actif.
Nous préférons agir de manière proactive plutôt que de subir les évolutions : c'est l'une de nos valeurs - et c'est exactement ce que nous attendons de notre développement commercial. Ne pas attendre que le marché vienne à nous - le conquérir activement.
*Conquérir - le cœur du poste*
* Identifier et acquérir activement les entreprises industrielles de la région Mittelland qui ne sont pas encore clientes.
* Fixer des rendez-vous qualifiés, identifier les besoins en matière d'élimination des déchets spéciaux et développer des solutions adaptées.
* Conclure : calculer les prix, établir les offres - même les plus complexes - et remporter la commande.
*Suivre - avec une discipline inflexible*
* Entretenir activement chaque contact : chez nous, un lead sans suivi est un lead perdu - et nous ne perdons aucun lead.
* Maintenir le CRM en temps réel : chaque visite, chaque action de relance, chaque opportunité est enregistrée.
* Gérer votre activité à l'aide d'indicateurs clés : rendez-vous qualifiés, taux de conclusion, pipeline. Vous les connaissez, les suivez et en assumez la responsabilité.
*Représenter*
* Être le visage de CRIDEC dans le Mittelland : événements sectoriels, partenaires, associations.
* Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe commerciale et s'appuyer sur nos deux sites d'Eclépens et Winterthour.
**Ce qui nous motive**
Chez CRIDEC, la protection est primordiale : c'est le véritable sens de notre travail. Nous préférons agir de manière proactive plutôt que de subir les évolutions, tenir nos promesses même lorsque c'est difficile, et avancer ensemble dans le respect mutuel. Dans ce poste, ces valeurs prennent une signification concrète : chaque promesse faite à un prospect est tenue, chaque action de relance annoncée est réalisée, et chaque client gagné est bien accompagné.
**Ce poste vous correspond si**
* La conquête de nouveaux clients est votre terrain de jeu : vous avez une expérience avérée et démontrable en acquisition B2B - et c'est ce que vous aimez dans ce métier.
* Vous êtes bilingue allemand - français, ou avez l'allemand comme langue maternelle avec d'excellentes connaissances en français (oral et écrit).
* Les objectifs basés sur les chiffres ne vous font pas peur : vous êtes habitué(e) à travailler avec des KPIs, un CRM et des rapports réguliers - et vous y voyez un outil, pas une contrainte.
* La vente industrielle est votre univers : vous connaissez les longs cycles de décision, les multiples interlocuteurs et les défis techniques - et savez comment tenir la distance du premier contact à la signature du contrat.
* Vous connaissez la région Mittelland (Berne, Soleure) et êtes prêt(e) à passer la majeure partie de votre temps sur le terrain.
*Ces cinq points sont indispensables. Sans eux, nous ne pourrons malheureusement pas prendre en compte votre candidature.*
Des connaissances dans le secteur des déchets, la chimie ou le domaine environnemental réglementé sont un avantage clair - nous vous formons cependant dans le domaine technique. Le talent pour l'acquisition et la persévérance ne s'apprennent pas.
**Vos compétences**
* Vous aimez ouvrir des portes - le premier contact vous stimule plutôt que de vous freiner.
* Résilience et endurance : un refus est pour vous une information, pas un échec - et un cycle de vente de dix-huit mois ne vous effraie pas.
* Orientation résultats : vous vous fixez des objectifs ambitieux et faites spontanément rapport de leur avancement.
* Organisation et suivi rigoureux : rien ne se perd, rien ne reste en suspens.
* Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des relations, tant avec les techniciens qu'avec les acheteurs. Sensibilité aux questions environnementales : vous vendez une solution utile - et vous y croyez.
**Ce que nous vous offrons**
* Un marché à conquérir : la Suisse alémanique est une priorité stratégique, et vous en êtes la force motrice.
* Un haut degré d'autonomie ainsi qu'une influence directe, visible et mesurable sur les résultats de l'entreprise.
* Une mission porteuse de sens dans un secteur central pour la transition écologique.
* Une entreprise à taille humaine, majoritairement publique, en forte croissance, où vos idées comptent.
* Une voiture de fonction.
* La possibilité de télétravail partiel.
* Le soutien de nos deux sites d'Eclépens et Winterthour ainsi que d'équipes fières de leur travail.
* Un salaire correspondant à votre expérience sur la base de 13 mois, ainsi que des prestations sociales attractives.
**Votre candidature**
Vous aimez conquérir de nouveaux marchés et construire un pipeline qui tient ses promesses ? Vous souhaitez mettre votre talent commercial au service d'une entreprise engagée pour l'environnement ?

Description
We’re growing and looking to hire a Sales Development Representative (SDR) who embodies our core values: People First, Customer Obsession, Strive for Excellence, and Integrity.

Claroty is seeking a driven, curious, and resilient SDR to help accelerate pipeline generation and support our continued growth across the APJ region. In this role, you will serve as a critical bridge between Marketing and Sales, identifying and engaging prospective customers across industrial, healthcare, commercial, and public sector organizations.
You will be responsible for outbound prospecting, qualifying opportunities, and building trusted relationships with key stakeholders. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth cybersecurity environment, enjoys proactive outreach, and is motivated by measurable business impact and career growth in enterprise technology sales.

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), your impact will be:
Research and identify target accounts, key stakeholders, and decision-makers across assigned territories and verticals
Execute outbound prospecting campaigns through email, phone, LinkedIn, and other engagement channels
Generate qualified pipeline opportunities for the sales organization through strategic outreach and discovery
Develop relationships with prospective customers by understanding their business priorities, operational challenges, and cybersecurity initiatives
Conduct qualification conversations to assess fit, urgency, and potential value alignment
Collaborate closely with Account Executives and Sales Leadership to prioritize outreach efforts and territory strategies
Partner with Marketing teams to provide feedback on campaigns, messaging, and market trends
Maintain accurate prospect activity, pipeline data, and engagement history within CRM systems
Stay informed on cybersecurity, OT/IoT/XIoT market trends, competitive positioning, and Claroty ’s platform capabilities
Meet and exceed KPI targets related to activity, meetings booked, pipeline contribution, and opportunity generation
Contribute to a high-performance, collaborative, and customer-focused sales culture

Strong communication and relationship-building skills across written, verbal, and virtual interactions

About Claroty
Claroty empowers organizations to protect the mission-critical infrastructure that underpins modern life.

The AI-powered Claroty Platform serves as the single source of operational truth, providing the deepest visibility and broadest protection across cyber-physical systems (CPS), leveraging five core solutions: asset inventory, exposure management, network protection, secure access, and threat detection.

Claroty helps organizations operationalize CPS protection through a programmatic approach designed to reduce risk, maintain operational integrity, and meet compliance–whether in the cloud with Claroty xDome or on-premise with Claroty Continuous Threat Detection (CTD). Claroty is deployed by hundreds of organizations at thousands of sites globally.

About Grubhub
At Grubhub, we believe food is more than just a meal: It’s a source of discovery, connection, and pure enjoyment. There’s a time and place for every type of dish, from hidden neighborhood gems to tried-and-true favorites, and we exist to connect people with the food they love in all the ways they like to dig in. We’ve been at it since 2004, but now, as part of Wonder , Grubhub is operating with a renewed sense of momentum and the high-velocity energy of a powerhouse startup.
As a leading U.S. ordering and delivery marketplace, we feature over 415,000 merchants in more than 4,000 cities, creating the ultimate food experience by elevating online ordering through innovative restaurant technology, easy-to-use platforms, and an improved delivery experience.

We are constantly finding new ways to innovate—from integrated grocery delivery with groceries powered by Instacart to exclusive loyalty programs. Join our team, based out of New York City, Chicago and Denver, and help us give our diners the exceptional value they deserve.
About The Opportunity
The Grubhub Sales Executive role is a great opportunity to leverage your sales skills to make an impact on the company’s rapid growth. Plus, you’ll be selling restaurant owners exactly what they already want: more business. Our current Sales Executive’s love the team events, contests, and of course the meal perks. This is the place to hone your sales skills, and make great money doing it.
You’ll be on the front lines of building Grubhub’s national restaurant partner network. You’ll research and consult with restaurants, contact and meet with decision makers, and show them how Grubhub can benefit their business. You’ll need to be resourceful, persuasive, determined, competitive, and have the ability to easily connect with people from all walks of life.
The Impact You Will Make
Discover Grubhub’s next wave of great local restaurants: We need you to engage the most wanted restaurants in your territory and help us discover those hidden gems our diners are craving.
Be the market expert: gather restaurant feedback, monitor competitor activity, marketing opportunities, and provide recommendations for improvement to management.
Consult with restaurant owners on the benefits of joining GrubHub and having access to our rapidly growing community of hungry diners. Identify needs and goals of the restaurant and demonstrate how Grubhub can help grow their business.
Conduct extensive cold calling (60+ dials per day), emailing, and social outreach to prospective decision makers.
Manage a territory and own the entire sales pipeline from prospecting to closing.
Secure appointments with prospective clients to uncover needs and present the value of a partnership.
Travel into the market to conduct in person sales pitches with merchant owners.
Exceed high-volume sales goals while working within a team environment.

Job Description
This role is part of the Customer Excellence Group (CEG). Our purpose is to accelerate platform adoption and drive customer business outcomes. We do this through a portfolio of services, delivered by world-class consultants, training and success professionals, our leading practices, methodologies, and tools, as well as our ecosystem of partners.

s.h: What you get to do in this role
s.t:
As a ServiceNow Services Account Executive, you will be responsible for selling a portfolio of service offerings designed to help our customers successfully adopt the products they have purchased and ultimately achieve the business outcomes they expected from utilizing our products.

These service offerings include our Impact success offering, product implementation services, and training. The Services Account Executive is well-versed in services and post-sales adoption strategies. They are a trusted advisor to the account team and our customers for successful implementation, adoption, and value realization.

A quota carrying role, the Services Account Executive owns the Services sales strategy by proactively creating demand for new Services opportunities and partnering with the ServiceNow Sales team and our partners to develop and successfully execute Services sales opportunities for their assigned territory.
Collaborate with software sales account teams, Customer Outcomes team members, and our eco-system of delivery partners
Develop and execute a services sales strategy in the designated territory with a target account list
Proactively create new Services opportunities (Impact, Implementation Services, and Training) in both new and installed base customers
Create pipeline and manage end-to-end forecasting process for Services opportunities
Serve as a trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their existing and future digital transformation roadmap and driving the right mix of ServiceNow services to meet their needs
Arrange and conduct Executive and CxO services-related discussions in alignment with the account strategy
Lead extended team in solutioning and scoping, and proposal development
Execute value-based selling methodology for Impact, Implementation Services, and Training opportunities

s.h: To be successful in this role you have
s.t:
Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
Minimum 12 years of previous services sales experience gained within a SaaS software or solution sales organization (or reasonably equivalent)
New account sales focus, operating independently to identify new opportunities
Existing relationships in large enterprise accounts a plus
Demonstrable track record of achieving Services, Success, or Training sales targets
Ability to communicate and collaborate across lines of business and multiple customer and partner personas, including executives
Strong operational command – managing end-to-end franchise
Travel up to 75% (depending on geography/region)

The Sales Associate is responsible for providing all Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) customers with world class customer service with an additional emphasis on courtesy.

Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an I can do that mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance.
At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly.

Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required. Please include MONTH/YEAR and HOURS per week for all previous work experience listed on the resume. If there is no indication of time in position, we will credit the minimum.

Für unseren Kunden – ein dynamisches und zukunftsorientiertes Unternehmen in Villmergen – suchen wir eine durchsetzungsstarke und proaktive Persönlichkeit für den Verkaufsinnendienst (80–100%).
Ihre Rolle: Dreh- und Angelpunkt im Betrieb
In dieser vielseitigen Drehscheibenfunktion sind Sie das bindende Glied zwischen unseren Kunden, der Arbeitsvorbereitung (AVOR) und der Produktion:
· Auftragsabwicklung & Kundenbetreuung: Selbstständiges Erfassen, Bearbeiten und Überwachen von Kundenaufträgen von der Anfrage bis zur Auslieferung.
· Schnittstellenmanagement: Enger Austausch und Abstimmung mit der AVOR und der Fertigung zur Sicherstellung von Lieferterminen und Kapazitäten.
· Angebotserstellung & Stammdatenpflege: Erstellen von Offerten, Pflegen von Kunden- und Artikelstammdaten im SAP sowie Nachfassaktionen.
· Reklamations- & Anfragenmanagement: Kompetente Beratung der Kundschaft am Telefon und per E-Mail sowie lösungsorientierte Handhabung von Beanstandungen.

· Ausbildung: Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundbildung (EFZ) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.
· Systemkompetenz: Versierter und verhandlungssicherer Umgang mit SAP (SD/MM von Vorteil) sowie fundierte MS-Office-Kenntnisse.
· Erfahrung: Berufserfahrung im Verkaufsinnendienst; Erfahrung in einem technischen oder industriellen Produktionsumfeld ist von grossem Vorteil.
· Persönlichkeit: Proaktive, lösungsorientierte und selbstständige Denk- und Arbeitsweise mit hoher Kommunikationsstärke.
· Sprachen: Stilsicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift; weitere Sprachen (z. B. Französisch oder Englisch) sind ein Plus.

· Eine verantwortungsvolle Schlüsselfunktion mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Eigenverantwortung.
· Ein eingespieltes, kollegiales Team und ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld.
· Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen und faire Sozialleistungen.
· Gute Erreichbarkeit und Parkmöglichkeiten am Standort Villmergen.

## Description ##
## Where passion meets opportunity ##
The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!
## Your Purpose ##
* The Visual Merchandising Manager is responsible for defining, implementing and continuously elevating the visual merchandising standards across all onboard retail environments of MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.
* The role ensures that every boutique delivers a premium and consistent guest experience while respecting the identity of each cruise brand and the visual standards of the world's leading luxury and premium brands.
* With a particular focus on Fashion & Accessories, the role also coordinates the visual execution of Watches & Jewelry and Beauty & Duty Free boutiques in close collaboration with brand partners and Category teams.
* Working across HQ functions, onboard retail teams, architects, designers and luxury maisons, the Visual Merchandising Manager transforms commercial strategies into inspiring retail environments that maximize customer engagement and commercial performance.

**Global Visual Merchandising Strategy**
* Develop and continuously evolve the global visual merchandising strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.
* Establish visual standards that reflect the positioning of each cruise brand while maintaining commercial effectiveness.
* Ensure consistency of visual execution across the global fleet.
* Develop seasonal visual merchandising calendars supporting commercial initiatives and product launches.
* Create scalable visual standards adaptable to different ship classes and boutique formats.
**Fashion & Accessories Visual Leadership**
* Lead all visual merchandising activities for Fashion & Accessories boutiques.
* Develop display concepts that enhance product storytelling and elevate the guest shopping experience.
* Optimize product presentation to improve visibility, conversion and average transaction value.
* Ensure collections are presented according to luxury retail best practices while adapting to operational realities onboard.
**Watches, Jewelry & Beauty Coordination**
* Coordinate with luxury watch, jewelry and beauty brands to ensure visual execution complies with brand guidelines.
* Manage the implementation of brand display furniture, point-of-sale materials, animations and seasonal campaigns.
* Coordinate installation of showcases, displays and branded environments during new openings and refurbishments.
* Act as the primary visual merchandising contact for supplier visual teams.
**Retail Experience & Guest Journey**
* Develop immersive retail experiences that encourage product discovery and storytelling.
* Ensure visual merchandising supports the overall guest journey across all retail spaces.
* Collaborate with Marketing to translate campaigns into engaging in-store experiences.
* Promote experiential retail through animations, pop-ups, product launches and seasonal activations.
**Newbuilds & Boutique Development**
* Support retail design for new ships, refurbishments and dry docks.
* Collaborate with architects, designers and Category teams to optimize store layouts and product presentation.
* Recommend fixtures, furniture, lighting, materials and display solutions aligned with luxury retail standards.
* Participate in boutique commissioning and opening preparations.
**Brand Standards & Governance**
* Develop and maintain the Global Visual Merchandising Guidelines.
* Conduct regular fleet audits to ensure compliance with visual standards.
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement through performance analysis and guest feedback.
* Maintain strong relationships with visual merchandising teams from luxury brand partners.
**Cross Functional Collaboration**
* Partner closely with Retail Operations to maximize onboard commercial execution.
* Work with Planning and Order Management to ensure optimal VM material delivery.
* Partner with Performance to monitor category profitability and investment performance.
* Interface with cross-functional departments and stakeholders to ensure optimal coordination, communication, alignment and execution across the organization.
**Leadership**
* Lead and develop the Visual Merchandising function across the organization.
* Inspire a culture of creativity, attention to detail and luxury excellence.
* Coach onboard visual champions and retail teams on visual merchandising best practices.
* Promote innovation while ensuring operational simplicity and executional consistency.
## Your Journey so far ##
* 8+ years of experience in Visual Merchandising within luxury fashion, premium retail or travel retail.
* Strong experience working with internationally recognized luxury and premium brands.
* Experience developing visual merchandising standards across multiple stores or international markets.
* Experience supporting new store openings and retail concept development.
* Experience in luxury department stores, fashion retail or travel retail is highly desirable.
## Your Essentials ##
* Deep understanding of luxury visual merchandising principles and premium customer experience.
* Strong aesthetic sensitivity combined with commercial awareness.
* Excellent knowledge of fashion presentation, styling and luxury retail codes.
* Experience collaborating with luxury brands and managing brand visual guidelines.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to work across multicultural and international environments.
* Creative mindset supported by strong execution capabilities.
* Willingness to travel internationally and onboard vessels regularly.
## Our commitment ##
We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.
Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

In 2020, VOI, BioMedtrix and KYON have joined forces and form a leading global veterinary orthopedic group Movora \- that complement and strengthen each other. Collectively, we now serve more than 50 markets around the world.

The group utilizes legacy expertise to deliver a broad range of innovative products by bringing together key leaders in veterinary medical technology to deliver progressive solutions.
Movora embodies a philosophy of always caring. Anticipating consumer needs and offering reliable solutions, alongside education, provide our customers with value beyond product. We are proudly thinking forward. We prioritize reinvention, individuality, and always making the next leap in innovation.
